question: Select the sentence that has the correct use of words and spellings from the options given below.

options.text: The scientiest meticulously analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionice the field.
The scientist meticulusly analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revaulutionise the field.
The scientist meticulously anelysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionise the feild.
The scientist meticulously analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionise the field.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"meticulously"** means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (सावधानीपूर्वक)

 
 
• **Example: **She **meticulously **planned every aspect of the event to ensure it would be a success.
 
 
 
• **"Analysed"** refers to examining methodically and in detail the constitution or structure of something, typically for purposes of explanation and interpretation. (विश्लेषण किया)
 
 
• **Example: **The researchers analysed the data from the experiment to draw meaningful conclusions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: The scientist meticulously analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionise the field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: The word "scientiest" is incorrectly spelled; it should be "scientist". The word "revolutionice" is incorrectly spelled; it should be "revolutionise". (वैज्ञानिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist meticulously analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionise the field.
 
 
 
• **Option 2**: The word "meticulusly" is incorrectly spelled; it should be "meticulously". The word "revaulutionise" is incorrectly spelled; it should be "revolutionise". (सावधानीपूर्वक)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist meticulously analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionise the field.
 
 
 
• **Option 3**: The word "anelysed" is incorrectly spelled; it should be "analysed". The word "feild" is incorrectly spelled; it should be "field". (विश्लेषण)
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist meticulously analysed the complex data, uncovering ground-breaking insights that would revolutionise the field.
